_comment: Playable species (2024 Player's Handbook; the file keeps its old name). Traits with a 'rule' tag are kernel traits (data/traits.json); 'choices' are made at creation (Character.choices); 'lineages' give their own darkvision, speed and spells (those the game has yet). Ability increases come from the background. standing: how some peoples tend to regard this species.

human.name: Human
human.description: The most numerous people of the realm: farmers, soldiers, priests and kings. Short-lived, ambitious and quarrelsome, humans rule most of the land and most of its troubles.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.text: You wake from every long rest with Heroic Inspiration: one failed roll tried again.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.text: You are proficient in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.text: You gain an origin feat of your choice.

elf.name: Elf
elf.description: Long-lived and few, keeping to deep forests and old halls. Many humans think them proud and uncanny; many elves think humans are a plague that learned to build.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You see in dim light as if it were bright, and in darkness as if it were dim, out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.text: Drow, high elf or wood elf: the blood of your lineage gives you its gifts (and, as you grow, its magic).

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end being charmed.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: You are proficient in Insight, Perception or Survival (your choice).

traits.name: Trance
traits.text: You do not need to sleep, and magic cannot put you to sleep: four hours of trance rest you like a night.

high_elf.name: High Elf
high_elf.text: Of the old courts and their libraries: a cantrip of the arcane, Detect Magic at level 3 and Misty Step at level 5.

wood_elf.name: Wood Elf
wood_elf.text: Of the deep forests: swift on your feet (speed 35), with Druidcraft, Longstrider at level 3 and Pass without Trace at level 5.

drow.name: Drow
drow.text: Of the halls under the earth: darkvision to 120 feet, Dancing Lights, Faerie Fire at level 3 and Darkness at level 5.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description: Stubborn, long-memoried folk of the mountain holds. They trade iron and grudges with equal care, and outlive three generations of the humans who cheat them.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You see in dim light as if it were bright, and in darkness as if it were dim, out to 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.text: Resistance to poison damage, and advantage on saving throws to avoid or end being poisoned.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.text: One more hit point at every level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.text: A bonus action on stone ground: tremorsense to 60 feet for ten minutes, as many times a long rest as your proficiency bonus.

halfling.name: Halfling
halfling.description: Small, quick and practical people of the farm country, easily overlooked and glad of it. They survive what kills bigger folk by being somewhere else when it arrives.

traits.name: Brave
traits.text: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end being frightened.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.text: You can move through the space of any creature a size larger than you (though not stop there).

traits.name: Luck
traits.text: A natural 1 on any d20 roll of yours (an attack, a check, a save) is rolled again.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.text: You can hide when only a creature larger than you stands between you and the one looking.

orc.name: Orc
orc.description: Big, hard and long-suffering, the orcs of the tribes and of the towns' rough quarters are trusted by few and blamed by many. They find work as soldiers, labourers and enforcers, and they are very hard to kill.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: You see in dim light as if it were bright, and in darkness as if it were dim, out to 120 feet.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.text: A bonus action: Dash, and gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus; as many times a short rest as your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.text: Once per long rest, when you would fall to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 instead.
